title: 第六千三百一十九章 心魔变聪明了第六千三百一十八章 迎战天外诡异
content_zh:
“轰隆！”
玄夜灵虎脑海中嗡鸣炸响，他整个人愣在原地，脑海中只剩下圣凰神王的话语在回答。
“圣凰，圣凰她学习人族，都是为了我……”
玄夜灵虎内心一片纷乱，连呼吸都忘了。
“玄夜，我想听你亲口告诉我……你喜欢我……”
耳边传来圣凰神王虚弱的声音。
玄夜灵虎回过神来，不知何时，他已经泪流满脸，连忙握紧圣凰神王的手。
“我喜欢你，圣凰，我真的喜欢你，你坚持住，我能救你。”
玄夜灵虎双手颤抖，他尝试着将神力注入圣凰神王体内，可神力注入进去如泥牛入海，毫无反应，他的内心越来越沉，越来越慌乱。
“别试了，玄夜，我知道我的身体状况。”
圣凰神王握紧了玄夜灵虎的手，眼神清澈，充满爱意。
“下辈子，要记得早点向我表达心意……”
随着圣凰神王话音落下，她的手掌也从玄夜灵虎的手心滑溜。
“啊啊啊啊啊！”
玄夜灵虎仰天哀嚎，声音凄厉至极。
“不好，这心魔学坏了！”
叶枫看到这一幕，面色微变，玄夜灵虎的心魔幻境和之前不同，心魔构建的幻象不只是天外诡异，还有圣凰神王，这心魔是故意让这一幕重演，以此来击溃玄夜灵虎的心灵，让他永恒沉沦在心魔幻境之中。
“该死的幻象，你痴心妄想！”
叶枫眼中杀意浮现，陡然俯冲而下，同时口中大喝，“玄夜灵虎，给我清醒过来！”
这一声怒吼，让沉浸在同时爱人的玄夜灵虎一怔，他茫然的抬起头，看到俯冲而下的叶枫，眼瞳猛然一颤。

不知为何，叶枫的面容让他有种格外熟悉，格外亲近的感觉，而且好像周遭的一切都变得有些虚幻，有些割裂……
“这，这是怎么回事？”
玄夜灵虎愈发茫然。
而天外诡异和己方世界的神王，神灵，竟然全部冲天而起，杀向叶枫。
“哈哈哈哈，你急了！”
叶枫口中大笑，这些神王神灵，都是心魔幻化而出的幻象，见到叶枫要唤醒玄夜灵虎因此出手阻止。
“你觉得你能阻止我？”
叶枫狞笑一声，身后浮现他的虚影，虚影顶天立地，比神王还要伟岸，镇压诸天的浩荡神威弥漫开来。
一众幻象目露惊骇。
“神帝，传说中的神帝！”
“不可能，他怎么是神帝境的存在，这不可能啊！”
“这是什么怪物，快快杀了他！”
一众幻象纷纷开口怒吼。
玄夜灵虎则是痴痴看着，愈发感到迷惑，这个世界……似乎很古怪。
“都给我死！”
叶枫操控幻影，一掌拍下。
迎面而来的神王，神灵，全部倒飞而下，坠落九天。
一掌便是镇压整个世界，乃至天外诡异，这等盖世神威，让玄夜灵虎心头巨颤。
“不对，不对，他是谁，好熟悉的感觉！”
玄夜灵虎眼神浮现挣扎之色，他怀中的圣凰神王突然睁开双眼，竟然又活过来，身上的伤势都消失不见。

“玄夜，你怎么了？”
content_en:
"Boom!"
There was a buzzing sound in Xuan Ye Linghu's mind, and he froze on the spot. Only the words of the Holy Phoenix God King were left in his mind to answer.
"Holy Phoenix, Holy Phoenix, she studied human race, all for me..."
Xuanye Linghu's heart was in chaos, and he even forgot to breathe.
"Xuan Ye, I want to hear you tell me personally... that you like me..."
The weak voice of the Holy Phoenix God King came to his ears.
Xuanye Linghu came back to his senses, and at some point, tears were streaming down his face, and he quickly held the hand of the Holy Phoenix God King.
"I like you, Holy Phoenix, I really like you. Just hold on, I can save you."
Xuanye Linghu's hands were trembling. He tried to inject divine power into the body of the Holy Phoenix God King, but the infusion of divine power was like a mud cow entering the sea. There was no response. His heart became heavier and heavier, and he became more and more panicked.
"Don't try, Xuan Ye, I know my physical condition."
The Holy Phoenix God King held Xuanye Linghu's hand tightly, his eyes clear and full of love.
"In the next life, remember to express your feelings to me early..."
As the Holy Phoenix God King finished speaking, her palms slipped from Xuanye Linghu's.
"Ahhhhhh!"
The Xuanye Spirit Tiger looked up to the sky and howled, the sound was extremely shrill.
"No, this inner demon has gone bad!"
When Ye Feng saw this scene, his expression changed slightly. Xuan Ye Linghu's inner demon illusion was different from before. The illusion constructed by the inner demon was not only weird outside the world, but also the Holy Phoenix God King. This inner demon deliberately let this scene happen again in order to defeat Xuanye Linghu's mind and make him sink into the inner demon illusion forever.
"Damn illusion, you are delusional!"
Ye Feng's eyes showed murderous intent, and he suddenly swooped down, shouting at the same time, "Xuan Ye Linghu, wake up!"
This roar made Xuan Ye Linghu, who was immersed in his lover at the same time, startled. He raised his head blankly and saw Ye Feng swooping down, his pupils trembled suddenly.
For some reason, Ye Feng's face made him feel extra familiar and close, and it seemed that everything around him had become a little unreal and a little fragmented...
"What, what's going on?"
Xuanye Linghu became more and more confused.
However, the strange kings and gods from the outside world and their own world all rose into the sky and killed Ye Feng.
"Hahahaha, you're in a hurry!"
Ye Feng laughed loudly. These gods, kings and spirits were all illusions created by inner demons. When he saw Ye Feng trying to awaken the Xuanye Spirit Tiger, he took action to stop it.
"You think you can stop me?"
Ye Feng laughed evilly, and his phantom appeared behind him. The phantom stood tall against the sky and the earth, more majestic than the God King, and the mighty divine power that suppressed the heavens filled the air.
All the illusions looked horrified.
"God Emperor, the legendary God Emperor!"
"Impossible, how can he exist in the realm of God Emperor? This is impossible!"
"What kind of monster is this? Kill him quickly!"
All the illusions roared.
Xuanye Linghu looked at it foolishly, becoming more and more confused. This world... seemed very strange.
"You all die!"
Ye Feng controlled the phantom and captured it with one palm.
The oncoming god kings and gods all flew upside down and fell into the sky for nine days.
One palm can suppress the entire world, and even the weirdness outside the sky. Such unparalleled divine power makes Xuanye Linghu's heart tremble.
"No, no, who is he? It feels so familiar!"
A look of struggle appeared in Xuanye Linghu's eyes. The Holy Phoenix God King in his arms suddenly opened his eyes and came to life again, with all the injuries on his body disappearing.
"Xuan Ye, what's wrong with you?"
